---
📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough MetaCache gains an async PurgeDirectoryChildren API that enqueues a purge request into the apply loop. The apply-loop handler skips purges for directories being built, runs an optional reset callback, and deletes cached children under lock. WFS adds purgeDirectoryCache to call this API and invalidate inode-to-path children cache. ## Changes **Directory Cache Async Purge** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**MetaCache Purge API: State Machine and Handler**
`weed/mount/meta_cache/meta_cache.go`|`metadataPurgeDir` request kind, `metadataApplyRequest.resetFn`, public `MetaCache.PurgeDirectoryChildren`, and `purgeDirectoryChildrenNow` handler that checks `buildingDirs`, invokes `resetFn` if present, and deletes cached children under lock.| |**MetaCache Purge Tests**
`weed/mount/meta_cache/meta_cache_purge_test.go`|Test helpers (`insertCacheEntry`, barrier) and two regression tests: `TestPurgeSkippedWhileDirectoryBuilding` and `TestPurgeClearsWhenNotBuilding`.| |**WFS Purge Helper and Eviction Loop Update**
`weed/mount/weedfs.go`|New internal `purgeDirectoryCache(dirPath)` calling `metaCache.PurgeDirectoryChildren` and invalidating `inodeToPath` children cache; updates `loopEvictIdleDirCache` and clarifies `markDirectoryReadThrough` documentation.| |**Caller Updates: File Copy and Forget**
`weed/mount/weedfs_file_copy_range.go`, `weed/mount/weedfs_forget.go`|Replace `markDirectoryReadThrough`/`DeleteFolderChildren` calls with `purgeDirectoryCache`; remove unused `context` import.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes ## Possibly related PRs - [seaweedfs/seaweedfs#9529](https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/pull/9529): Both PRs modify `(*WFS).Forget` to adjust post-lock cleanup behavior for directory children in the metadata cache. ## Poem > 🐰 Hopping through the apply-loop gate, > Purge queued up, I patiently wait, > If building, I skip with a thump and a thunk, > If clear, I nudge caches and clear out the junk, > Tiny paws tidy trees—snap!—no more clunk.

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
